images.prompt: Polished landscape 16:9 gameplay screenshot of a narrative editing game titled "붉은 펜으로 남긴 것". Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Camera: top-down on a warm oak desk in soft afternoon window light with faint leaf shadows; a large ruled manuscript page fills the center with Korean serif prose. Core mechanic visible: one sentence crossed out by a hand-drawn red pen strike, a phrase replaced with a red handwritten caret correction above it, and the last paragraph lifted off the page in a dashed red frame being dragged upward to a red insertion line near the top. A red fountain pen rests on the page. A yellow sticky note from the author and a green note from the publisher are taped at the edge. Left: a small vertical tool tray (strike, replace, move, undo) with the strike tool active in red. Right: a dark panel with two separate gauges, reader clarity in slate blue and author voice in red. Palette: warm paper cream, oak brown, editor red, ink black. Tactile and intimate. Korean UI: "붉은 펜으로 남긴 것", gauges "이해도" and "목소리", button "수정 원고 돌려보내기".
